features.title: Features
features.intro: The parts Ahab is made of. Switch off what you don't use: its sidebar view, commands, + entries and shortcuts go away for everyone on this server. Nothing is deleted, and switching it back on brings it all back.

editor.title: Editor
editor.intro: How file windows look and behave. A project can open its files editable, or not, whatever is set here (Settings → Projects).

agentEditor.title: Agent editor
agentEditor.intro: How chats with agents read and how you write to them: the transcript and session usage on this device, the composer for everyone on this server.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.thinkingDescription: An agent's thinking opens as it comes, instead of folded.
transcript.tools: Show commands and tool calls expanded
transcript.toolsDescription: Commands with their output, file changes and other tool calls open as they come.

usage.title: Session usage
usage.description: What a chat's Session usage shows, beside its composer. Kept on this device.
usage.tokensDescription: The tokens the session has spent, added up over its turns.
usage.costDescription: What the session cost in US dollars, for agents that report it.

labels.problemsAtLineEnd: Show problems at the end of the line
labels.chatWhileWorking: Messages sent while the agent works
labels.chatVim: Vim key bindings in the chat composer

keyboard.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.intro: Open an action to give it other keys. Changes are kept in this browser.
keyboard.allReset: Every shortcut is back to Ahab's keys.
keyboard.filterListening: Press the keys to look for…
keyboard.findByKeys: Find a shortcut by pressing its keys

noMatch.title: No shortcut matches
noMatch.keyFree: <key/> is free: open an action to give it to one.
noMatch.tryAnother: Try another word, or press the keys instead.

keyboard.editorNote: These work while a file's editor has the focus. With Vim on, Vim's own keys come first (Ctrl+D scrolls), and these have the keys Vim leaves.
keyboard.chatNote: These work while a request in a chat has the focus, not while you type in it.

vim.title: Vim mappings
vim.intro: With Vim key bindings on (Settings → Editor), keys you type can stand for others, as Vim's :map makes them: jk for <Esc> in insert mode, or <C-s> for :w<CR>. Kept in this browser.
vim.ahabKeys: Ahab adds gd (definition), gy (type definition), gi (implementation), gr (references), K and gh (hover), ]d and [d (problems); gc and gcc comment lines out. A mapping reaches them only when it is recursive; others reach Vim's own keys.

problems.lhsEmpty: Not applied: type the keys to map.
problems.rhsEmpty: Not applied: type the keys they stand for.
problems.exCommand: Not applied: Ex commands (:w) cannot be mapped here, only keys.
problems.typing: Not applied: a single character in insert mode could no longer be typed.
problems.same: Not applied: the keys stand for themselves.
problems.duplicate: Not applied: an earlier mapping in this mode has the same keys.
problems.unknownKey: Not applied: {{key}} is not a key the editor's Vim knows.

keyboard.terminalNoteMac: In a terminal, ⌘ keys go to Ahab and ⌃ keys stay with the shell.
keyboard.terminalNote: In a terminal, plain Ctrl+letter keys (Ctrl+K, Ctrl+W) stay with the shell, except Go to file's.
keyboard.browserNote: Keys a browser tab keeps for itself, such as Ctrl+T, work only when Ahab is installed as an app.

editor.needsModifierMac: Hold ⌃, ⌥ or ⌘ too: without it, the key would fire while you type.
editor.needsModifier: Hold Ctrl or Alt too: without it, the key would fire while you type.
editor.appOnly: App only: a browser tab keeps it
editor.noKeys: No keys: it runs from the palette only.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: How Ahab looks on this device. Each browser and app keeps its own, so a phone and a desktop can differ.

theme.title: Theme
theme.systemNowDark: The system is dark now; Ahab follows when it changes.
theme.systemNowLight: The system is light now; Ahab follows when it changes.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Scale the interface, including chats, the editor and terminals.

motion.title: Motion
motion.reduceDescription: No animations or sliding panels, even when the system allows them.

language.title: Language
language.description: Ahab is in English for now; more languages can be added.

colorTheme.title: Colour theme
colorTheme.description: Its light or dark colours follow the theme chosen above; a theme with only one shows it either way.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: For this device. Another font is used by its name: install it on this computer first.
fonts.name: {{what}}: font name
